    outs = r.stdout.decode().splitlines()
    bad = []
    if r.returncode: print('rc', r.returncode, r.stderr[:1000])
    if len(outs) != len(CASES):
        print('LINE COUNT', len(outs), len(CASES)); return 1
    for i, (name, line, exp) in enumerate(CASES):

            got = json.loads(outs[i])

        else:
            if got == {'error': 'input'}: bad.append((name, 'unexpected input error'))
    print('edge cases:', len(CASES), 'failures:', len(bad))

    return 1 if bad else 0
